name: Djuro Koruga
abstract_title:
TRISKELION CONSCIOUSNESS: 

Darwin's paradox and the phenomenon of consciousness
abstract: Abstract: Mathematics and numbers are the universal language with which we describe the laws of nature, try to understand the world, and use them to create machines as new realities. Richard Feynman had a high opinion of numbers because “we use them in all our theories, but we don’t understand them – what they are or where they come from. I believe that from a fundamental point of view this is a very interesting and serious problem” (Feynman, QED: the strange theory of light and matter, 1985). H
notable: Founder of NanoLab at U. of Belgrade; Nikola Tesla Golden Medal; 3 US Patents; visiting professor at U. of Arizona, Tokyo Tech
